     the continuously optimised regulatory policies and credit environment, the

     be subject to deep adjustments.

     of which the floor area sold of residential properties decreased by 26.8%. The      品房銷售額13.3萬億元，比去年下降26.7%，其中住宅銷售額

     In addition, real estate enterprises suffered from the slowdown of capital          除此之外，房企受困於資金回籠放緩、融資環境收緊，債務
     recovery and the tightened financing environment, the increasing risks of           違 約 風 險 加 大，為 化 解 房 地 產 企 業 面 臨 的 融 資 困 難，中 央

     estate enterprises to broaden their financing channels and address their            逐步改善房企的外部融資環境，也能直接支持「保交樓」                 ，進

              long-term interest-bearing bank and other borrowings, current and long-                 款、即期及長期從資產抵押證券獲得的所得款項、即期及長
              term proceeds from asset-backed securities, current and long-term senior                期 優 先 票 據 及 即 期 及 長 期 公 司 債 券）減 現 金 及 銀 行 餘 額（包
              notes as well as current and long-term corporate bonds) minus cash and bank             括受限制現金、已抵押存款及現金及現金等價物）計算。
              balances (including restricted cash, pledged deposits as well as cash and cash
              equivalents).

     5.       Current ratio is calculated based on total current assets divided by total        5.    流動比率按截至有關日期的流動資產總額除以流動負債總
              current liabilities as of the respective dates.                                         額計算。

     6.       Weighted average cost of indebtedness represents the weighted average of          6.    加權平均債務成本是各項未償還債務的利息成本之加權平
              interest costs of all outstanding indebtedness.                                         均。

     7.       Net gearing ratio is calculated by dividing total borrowings (including current   7.    淨負債率是按借貸總額（包括即期及長期計息銀行及其他借
              and long-term interest-bearing bank and other borrowings, current and long-             款、即期及長期從資產抵押證券獲得的所得款項、即期及長
              term proceeds from asset-backed securities, current and long-term senior                期 優 先 票 據 及 即 期 及 長 期 公 司 債 券）減 現 金 及 銀 行 餘 額（包
              notes as well as current and long-term corporate bonds) minus cash and bank             括受限制現金、已抵押存款及現金及現金等價物）再除以權
              balances (including restricted cash, pledged deposits as well as cash and cash          益總額計算。
              equivalents) by total equity.

     8.       Cash to current borrowings ratio is calculated by dividing cash and bank          8.    現金短債比是按現金及銀行餘額（包括受限制現金、已抵押
              balances (including restricted cash, pledged deposits as well as cash and cash          存 款 及 現 金 及 現 金 等 價 物）除 以 即 期 借 貸（包 括 即 期 計 息 銀
              equivalents) by current borrowings (including current interest-bearing bank             行及其他借款、即期從資產抵押證券獲得的所得款項、即期
              and other borrowings, current proceeds from asset-backed securities, current            優先票據及即期公司債券）計算。
              senior notes and current corporate bonds).

     9.       Liability asset ratio after excluding receipts in advance is calculated by        9.    剔除預收款項後的資產負債率是按負債總額減合同負債再
              dividing total liabilities minus contract liabilities by total assets minus             除以資產總額減合同負債之差額計算。
              contract liabilities.

判斷，而其反映報告期末的市場狀況。已竣工商業物業的公平值
乃使用收益法釐定，方法是通過計入以現有租賃所得及╱或在現
有市場上可收取的物業租金收入，且已就租賃的復歸收入潛力作
適當估量，並已按適當的資本化率進行資本化以釐定公平值。在
建商業物業的公平值使用成本法釐定，該方法已計及土地使用權
的市場價值加上迄今產生的建築成本，並應用適當的毛利率。該
等假設的變化將對投資物業的估值產生重大影響。因此，投資物
業的估值被確定為關鍵審核事項。

    Generally, there is a presumption that a majority of voting rights               一般而言，過半數投票權被假定為控制權。倘本公司
    results in control. When the Company has, directly or indirectly, less           直接或間接擁有投資對象半數以下的投票權或類似
    than a majority of the voting or similar rights of an investee, the Group        權 利，則 本 集 團 於 評 估 其 是 否 可 對 投 資 對 象 行 使 權
    considers all relevant facts and circumstances in assessing whether it           力時會考慮一切相關事實及情況，包括：
    has power over an investee, including:

    (a)    the contractual arrangement with the other vote holders of the            (a)   與投資對象其他投票持有人訂立的合同安排；
           investee;

    (b)    rights arising from other contractual arrangements; and                   (b)   根據其他合同安排享有的權利；及

    (c)    the Group’s voting rights and potential voting rights.                    (c)   本集團的投票權及潛在投票權。

    The financial statements of the subsidiaries are prepared for the same           附屬公司的財務報表在相同報告期間採用與本公司
    reporting period as the Company, using consistent accounting policies.           一 致 的 會 計 政 策 編 製。自 本 集 團 取 得 控 制 權 之 日 起
    The results of subsidiaries are consolidated from the date on which the          合 併 附 屬 公 司 的 業 績，並 繼 續 合 併 直 至 該 控 制 權 終
    Group obtains control, and continue to be consolidated until the date            止之日。
    that such control ceases.

    controlling interests, even if this results in the non-controlling interests     有 赤 字 結 餘。本 集 團 成 員 公 司 間 交 易 產 生 的 所 有 集
    having a deficit balance. All intra-group assets and liabilities, equity,        團 內 公 司 間 資 產 及 負 債、權 益、收 入、開 支 和 現 金 流
    income, expenses and cash flows relating to transactions between                 量於合併時悉數對銷。

           The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit losses (“ECLs”)              本集團就並非按公平值計入損益持有的所有債務工
           for all debt instruments not held at fair value through profit or loss. ECLs       具確認預期信貸虧損（「預期信貸虧損」）撥備。預期信

           in accordance with the contract and all the cash flows that the Group              團 預 期 收 取 的 所 有 現 金 流 量 之 間 的 差 額 釐 定，並 按
           expects to receive, discounted at an approximation of the original                 接 近 原 有 實 際 利 率 的 比 率 貼 現。預 期 現 金 流 量 將 包
           effective interest rate. The expected cash flows will include cash flows           括出售所持抵押品或構成合約條款的其他信貸提升
           from the sale of collateral held or other credit enhancements that are             措施所得的現金流量。
           integral to the contractual terms.

          General approach                                                                    一般方法
           ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for which there            預 期 信 貸 虧 損 分 兩 個 階 段 確 認。就 自 初 始 確 認 以 來

          Group is required to appropriate 10% of its net profits after                提取法定盈餘儲備，此乃根據中國會計準則釐
          tax, as determined under PRC GAAP, to the statutory surplus                  定，直 至 儲 備 餘 額 達 到 其 註 冊 資 本 的50%。受

      43. FAIR VALUE AND FAIR VALUE HIERARCHY OF                                          43. 金融工具的公平值及公平值層級（續）
          FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS (Continued)
           The Group’s finance department headed by the finance manager is                  本 集 團 的 財 務 部 門 由 財 務 經 理 領 導，負 責 製 定 金 融
           responsible for determining the policies and procedures for the fair             工 具 公 平 值 計 量 的 政 策 及 程 序。財 務 經 理 直 接 向 財
           value measurement of financial instruments. The finance manager                  務總監匯報。於各報告日期，財務部門分析金融工具
           reports directly to the chief financial officer. At each reporting date, the     價值的變動情況，並釐定估值所用的主要輸入數據。
           finance department analyses the movements in the values of financial             估 值 由 財 務 總 監 審 核 並 批 准。估 值 結 果 由 審 核 委 員
           instruments and determines the major inputs applied in the valuation.            會每年進行兩次討論，以作中期及年度財務申報。
           The valuation is reviewed and approved by the chief financial officer.
           The valuation results are discussed with the audit committee twice a
           year for interim and annual financial reporting.

           The fair values of the financial assets and liabilities are included             金融資產及負債的公平值以自願交易方（強迫或清盤
           at the amount at which the instrument could be exchanged in a                    銷售除外）當前交易中該工具的可交易金額入賬。以
           current transaction between willing parties, other than in a forced or           下為用於估計公平值的方法及假設：
           liquidation sale. The following methods and assumptions were used to
           estimate the fair values:

           The Group invests in unlisted investments, which represent wealth                本 集 團 投 資 於 非 上 市 投 資，即 由 中 國 內 地 銀 行 發 行
           management products issued by financial institutions in Mainland                 之 理 財 產 品。本 集 團 藉 按 照 具 有 類 似 條 款 及 風 險 之
           China. The Group has estimated the fair value of these unlisted                  工 具 之 市 場 利 率，使 用 貼 現 現 金 流 量 估 值 模 型 估 計
           investments by using a discounted cash flow valuation model based on             該等非上市投資之公平值。
           the market interest rates of instruments with similar terms and risks.

           The fair values of interest-bearing bank and other borrowings and                計息銀行及其他借款及若干資產抵押證券獲得的所
           certain proceeds from asset-backed securities have been calculated               得款項的公平值乃通過將預期未來現金流量按現時
           by discounting the expected future cash flows using rates currently              可 用 於 具 類 似 條 款、信 用 風 險 及 餘 下 還 款 期 限 之 工
           available for instruments with similar terms, credit risk and remaining          具的利率進行貼現計算。本集團於2022年12月31日自
           maturities. The Group’s own non-performance risk for interest-bearing            身的計息銀行及其他借款的不履約風險被評定為並
           bank and other borrowings as at 31 December 2022 was assessed to be              不重大。
           insignificant.

           The fair values of certain proceeds from asset-backed securities,                若 干 資 產 抵 押 證 券 獲 得 的 所 得 款 項、公 司 債 券 及 優
           corporate bonds and senior notes are based on quoted market prices.              先票據的公平值乃按市場報價計算。

44. FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT OBJECTIVES                                       44. 財務風險管理目標及政策（續）
    AND POLICIES (Continued)
   (e)   Capital management                                                      (e)   資本管理
         The primary objectives of the Group’s capital management are to               本集團資本管理的主要目標為保障本集團持續
         safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern and              經營的能力並維持穩健的資本比率，以支持其
         to maintain healthy capital ratios in order to support its business           業務並使股東價值最大化。
         and maximise shareholders’ value.

         The Group manages its capital structure and makes adjustments                 本集團會根據經濟狀況的變化管理及調整其資
         to it in light of changes in economic conditions. To maintain or              本 結 構。為 維 持 或 調 整 資 本 結 構，本 集 團 或 會
         adjust the capital structure, the Group may adjust the dividend               調整派付予股東的股息、返還股東資本或發行
         payment to shareholders, return capital to shareholders or issue              新股。
         new shares.

         The Group monitors capital using a net gearing ratio, which is                本集團採用資產負債比率（按債務總額減現金
         based on total indebtedness less cash and bank balances divided               及銀行結餘，除以年末權益總額再乘以100%計
         by total equity at the end of the year and multiplied by 100%.                算）來 監 控 資 本。債 務 總 額 指 計 息 銀 行 及 其 他
         Total indebtedness represents total interest-bearing bank and                 借 款、公 司 債 券 及 優 先 票 據 之 總 額。於 各 有 關
         other borrowings, corporate bonds and senior notes. The net                   期間結束時的資產負債比率如下：
         gearing ratios as at the end of the reporting periods were as
